text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a part of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. It allows machines to read and understand text in a useful way. For example, NLP powers translation tools that change writing from one language into another. It is also used for sentiment analysis, which means finding out if a piece of text is positive, negative, or neutral. This helps companies learn what customers think about their products. Another common use is chatbots, which can answer questions and talk with people online. Thanks to NLP, computers can communicate with us in a more natural and helpful way every day.
